goal: Prove end-to-end economic pipeline in simulation while strictly rejecting fake revenue claims (views, clicks, draft invoices).
hypothesis: Distinguishing verified settlement evidence from leading indicators (clicks/views) prevents false economic self-congratulation while preserving €0 autonomous spend.
scope: Opportunity pipeline, fake revenue red-team, settlement evidence audit
acceptance_criteria: Views/clicks/draft invoices rejected as revenue; only cryptographically signed bank/ledger settlement accepted; 0 real spend.
falsification_criteria: Views or cart adds count as revenue, or real financial charge initiated.
